title: Trade Assurance case: TakarSettle6 deal 0
order: PO-7781: 1,000 stainless fasteners kits at USD 12.40, Tallinn -> Helsinki, delivered (DAP Helsinki West Harbour)
terms_on_chain: Pays the supplier when MEGASTAR is berthed at Helsinki West Harbour (two vessel miners on different operators), the invoice reconciles with the PO and goods-received note (two reconcile miners), and the supplier screens clear (two screening miners + Praman). Disagreement = review, not payment. Test USDC, scaled 1:12,400. After arrival is recorded the buyer has 30 minutes to confirm or object; silence releases the payment (automatic confirmation).
note: Illustrative order (the supplier is not a real company; test USDC scaled 1:12,400). The ship, the miners, every paid answer and every transaction are real, on Ethereum Sepolia.

replay.rule: lib/trade.mjs replay(): each round re-decided from the answers it stored
